scope: Offline evidence consistency verification only;DE-W105 and actual worker/native/external qualification remain open.

format.manifest_evidence: org.disked.differential-evidence/1: contract and generator artifact descriptors,case fixture descriptors,and participant identity/profile descriptors;all known before collection.
format.descriptor: {path,bytes,sha256};relative POSIX path under finalized owned artifact root;ordinary single-link files only;2MiB per artifact,32MiB unique payload cache,2048 files,128MiB reads per pass. Every distinct file is read/hash-checked;identical content may share memory. Recheck at the end.
format.snapshot: Caller supplies SHA256 of canonical sorted compact ASCII JSON of the complete predeclared manifest. Do not learn the expected snapshot from collected output. Hashes establish consistency,not execution authentication.
format.policy: Each expected tuple may carry policy;complete evidence requires it. comparison=native|projection|diagnostic;exact argv,relative participant input_path,allowed_outcomes(completed/refused),timeout_seconds. Derive the original fixture argument from the declared profile workspace and path_style.
format.identity: Bound JSON identity includes participant,role,profile,source(revision,inputs,upstream_source_verified),build(configuration,toolchain,executables). Native source revision is exact40hex;reference upstream source may remain explicitly unverified. Receipt and every row bind the expected identity SHA.
format.record: Raw stdout/stderr descriptors;native request descriptor;before snapshot and actual after/input-path descriptors. Verify exact display/hex/hash values,argv,elapsed time,status/exit relationships and fixture bytes. Recompute native checks/projection and external projections from retained raw bytes.
format.outcomes: Evidence complete/incomplete/invalid/unverified;execution completed/refused/timed_out/crashed/unavailable;agreement/disagreement/not_comparable separately. Required timeout/crash/unavailability never yields complete success. Refusal may be complete evidence but cannot pass a successful-projection control.
format.success: Only complete bindings,allowed required execution and successful common controls enable complete_success. Valid noncontrol disagreements remain retained and never choose a GPT winner. This is not product/OS/hardware qualification.

regressions: One complete synthetic packet passes consistency checks without asserting real tool execution.
Missing/wrong manifest snapshot,participant/code/profile/contract/generator identity,raw artifacts or changed fixture cannot pass.
Duplicate/unknown/diagnostic-only observations remain subject to the exact set check.
Raw bytes and their recorded projections/displays cannot contradict each other.
Fully identified refusal,timeout,crash,unavailability and valid completed disagreement remain distinct.
Traversal,links,hard links,excess bytes and artifact changes are refused within managed scratch.
forbidden: No physical media,elevation,new tool install,obsolete WSL runner,native capture retry,owner acceptance or main integration.
